samplingPlan.rationale: Owner-approved discovery-balanced sample. It represents major food-place types and business models while deliberately oversampling rural barangays so strong urban coverage cannot hide geographic gaps. Provider coverage must not influence place selection.
samplingPlan.newlyOpenedDefinition: Opened during the 12 months before the sampling-plan lock date.
samplingPlan.geographyDefinition: Urban and rural use the Philippine Statistics Authority classifications shown for Tagum's 23 barangays. The rural quota operationalizes the approved less-dense stratum.
